name: PFC Furniture Industries, Inc. (Wholesale Distributor)
old_description: Browse dealer-only furniture categories available through PFC Furniture Industries.
about:
PFC Furniture Industries, Inc. operates as a wholesale furniture distributor from its base in Richardson, Texas, within the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. The company supplies independent furniture retailers across Texas and most of Oklahoma with a range of home furnishings.

The distributor carries living room, bedroom, dining, and bedding collections, along with close-out items and a custom rustic farmhouse line. Retail dealers access wholesale pricing and current inventory through an online portal, while consumers can browse products and request a local dealer referral. Monthly specials feature discounted pieces such as hutches, bunk beds, and pet kennels, often in limited stock.

PFC Furniture Industries serves independent furniture retailers as its primary customer base, covering a geographic footprint that spans Texas and extends into Oklahoma. The company does not sell directly to end consumers, instead directing them to authorized dealers in their area. Product categories span mainstream residential furniture as well as niche rustic farmhouse styles.

The business emphasizes dealer-only wholesale access, a referral network for consumers, and rotating close-out discounts as its core service model.

name: PFI
old_description: The Grote Company Family of Brands has provided food processing equipment, parts, and services for
about:
PFI operates from San Antonio, Texas, as part of The Grote Company Family of Brands. The business traces its roots back over 60 years to KOFAB and Meyer Industries before becoming PFI, and it remains a family-run operation under the Grote family's leadership. The company was built to provide food manufacturers with a team of experts delivering complete conveying solutions and dedicated support.

PFI manufactures sanitary, custom-configured conveying and handling equipment for the food processing industry. Its product line includes belt conveyors, bucket and incline conveyors, dumpers, horizontal motion conveyors, and vibratory conveyors and feeders. The company also supplies replacement parts such as conveyor belts, elevator buckets, pulleys, and stainless steel hydraulic cylinders, and offers technical service, in-house installation, and maintenance training.

The equipment serves a wide range of food sectors including bakery, candy and confectionery, cereal, dairy, frozen food, fruits and vegetables, meat, poultry and seafood, nuts, pasta, pet food, ready-to-eat meals, and snack food. Customers include Hormel, a bakery processor, a snacks processor, and a large food processor, all of whom have cited PFI's responsiveness and integration expertise.

PFI emphasizes dependable solutions built for long-term viability, integration-ready designs that fit existing lines, sanitary construction that meets or exceeds regulations, a collaborative approach with OEMs and engineering firms, and a commitment to support customers before, during, and after projects.

name: PFI Inc. - PCBA Electronic Assembly Equipment
about:
PFI Inc. operates from Longwood, Florida, supplying surface-mount and through-hole assembly equipment to electronics manufacturers. The company's founding year, ownership structure, and founders are not disclosed in public sources.

The business stocks and resells a broad range of SMT and PCBA machinery across categories that include pick-and-place, AOI/SPI, cleaning, conformal coating, conveyors, dispensing, insertion, reflow, rework, routing, screen printing, wave/selective soldering, tape-and-reel, ICT/flying-probe test, X-ray inspection, and feeder systems for major placement platforms. It also lists production supplies, lead-forming dies, material-handling, ultrasonic welding, environmental and vibration test chambers, wire-processing tools, and fume extraction. An in-house service technician team and a dedicated logistics department support installation, maintenance, and shipping.

Customers are primarily electronics manufacturers and contract assemblers building printed circuit board assemblies for sectors such as aerospace, defense, medical, automotive, and industrial controls, though the company does not publish a formal industry list.

No public statement from PFI Inc. describes a founding mission or a specific differentiator beyond the availability of in-house service and logistics support.

name: PGT Energy Solutions
old_description: Home Battery Solutions Are Saving Arizona Homeowners Thousands
about:
PGT Energy Solutions operates from Tempe, Arizona, serving the Phoenix metropolitan area. The company reports over 25 years of experience in the energy industry, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly stated.

The firm provides residential and commercial solar photovoltaic installation, battery energy storage systems, and grid-charged battery solutions designed for load shifting and backup power. Its services include system design, permitting, installation, and ongoing warranty support. The company works with equipment such as Tesla Powerwall and emphasizes configurations that avoid peak utility rates from Arizona Public Service (APS) and Salt River Project (SRP) without requiring rooftop solar. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

PGT Energy Solutions targets Arizona homeowners and businesses seeking to reduce electricity costs through time-of-use optimization and demand charge reduction. Typical customers include residents on APS or SRP rate plans who want to store off-peak grid electricity for use during peak hours, as well as commercial clients aiming to lower demand charges. The company also assists clients in accessing the 30% federal investment tax credit and Arizona-specific battery rebates.

The company highlights its NABCEP certification, Arizona-based installation teams, zero-down financing options, and BBB accreditation as differentiators. It positions itself as a local certified energy partner focused on helping customers achieve energy independence and grid stability through battery storage, with or without solar.

name: PHT Systems
old_description: Since 1981, we’ve served as an exclusive distributor of Henny Penny foodservice equipment in the Midwest and Southern California.
about:
PHT Systems is based in New Brighton, Minnesota, and was founded in 1981 as a distributor of Henny Penny pressure fryers. The company was purchased by Chris Reichert in December 2018, who serves as president and sets the company's vision and culture.

Today, PHT operates as a national wholesale distributor of foodservice equipment, breadings, seasonings, and supplies from manufacturers. It holds exclusive distribution rights for Henny Penny in the Midwest and Southern California. Beyond equipment sales, the company provides consulting, on-site training, service and repair through a team of in-house certified technicians, and maintains an extensive parts inventory to minimize customer downtime.

The company serves three primary customer segments: retail operations such as supermarkets and convenience stores; foodservice establishments including restaurants, universities, and hospitality venues; and dealer partners who rely on PHT for equipment, specialized training, and service support for their own customers.

PHT emphasizes a "whatever it takes" philosophy, focusing on long-term partnerships rather than transactional sales. Its differentiation lies in comprehensive post-sale support — hands-on equipment training, breading and seasoning program development, and a service promise that includes no charge for return trips if a needed part is not on the service truck.

name: PMC SMART Solutions
old_description: as part of this integrated system. PMC specializes in providing complex engineering and technical solutions for difficult-to-mold, high-temperature components.
about:
PMC SMART Solutions, headquartered in Shelbyville, Indiana, traces its origins to 1929 when two families founded Plastic Moldings Company in Cincinnati, Ohio, during the Great Depression. The business remains privately owned by the founding family, now led by fourth‑generation President and CEO Lisa Jennings, and earned WBE and WOSB certification in 2013.

The company specializes in complex engineering and technical solutions for difficult‑to‑mold, high‑temperature components. Its core capabilities include high‑temperature and implantable biomaterials injection molding, hyper‑precision and insert molding to micron tolerances, scientific injection molding, insert and over‑molding, design and engineering services, and complete secondary operations and assembly, delivering finished medical devices and automotive components.

PMC serves the medical device and automotive industries, counting global OEMs such as Medtronic and Bosch among its strategic customers. Its medical portfolio spans development through assembly of life‑saving products, while its automotive work emphasizes hyper‑precision molding and contract assembly for safety‑critical systems.

The firm differentiates itself through a quality system that has achieved first‑time certification on four registered standards and a 100 % success rate in external audits. Its SMART Solutions™ framework combines engineering, design, molding, and assembly under a culture of accountability, innovation, and stewardship, aiming to make customers’ products safer, stronger, and more affordable.

name: PMJ Technology
old_description: We are able to deliver quality samples with a quick turn-around time and at a competitive cost.
about:
PMJ Technology, headquartered in Arlington Heights, Illinois, with a manufacturing facility in Siheung City, South Korea, traces its origins to 1987 when Sam Kim, a former Daewoo Electronics executive, founded Daesam to bring Korean contract manufacturing expertise to U.S. customers. His son Walter Kim joined the business in 2013, and the company was rebranded as PMJ Technology Inc. in 2017—named for the initials of Walter’s three children—completing a generational ownership transition.

The company operates as an electronics contract manufacturer, offering prototyping, printed circuit board assembly (single-layer, multi-layer, flexible, LED, and RoHS/lead-free), injection molding and tooling (design, tool fabrication, rapid prototyping, and high-capacity production in thermoplastics such as PVC, ABS, PE, PP, polycarbonate, and nylon, including glass- or mineral-reinforced grades), cable harness assembly (standard and custom, with multi-connector and insert/over-molding capabilities), and turnkey box-build integration from component sourcing through final test. It supports project volumes ranging from prototypes to large production runs.

PMJ serves the agricultural, commercial, consumer, electronics, and industrial markets, with specific experience in agriculture, commercial and industrial equipment, and consumer electronics.

name: POPULAS Furniture
old_description: We are the first generation to spend half our waking hours in front of a computer—your workstation is your second home, and it should be worthy.
about:
POPULAS Furniture operates from Boise, Idaho, where it designs and manufactures adjustable ergonomic furniture for a broad range of users. The company was founded to address growing demand for workstations that accommodate diverse physical needs, positioning its products as a response to population-wide trends in computer-based work and accessibility requirements.

The product line spans desks, tables, computer workstations, therapy tables, kitchen and bath components, and workbenches, each offered with multiple adjustment modes including hand crank, motorized, knob-adjusted, tilt, and sit-to-stand mechanisms. Series such as Accella, Approach, Equity, Infinity, Progression, and Vox are engineered and assembled in the northwestern United States, with customer service staff also based domestically.

Primary markets include the military, education institutions, healthcare and rehabilitation facilities, commercial workplaces, industrial environments, and accessible residential kitchen and bath projects. The company holds a GSA contract for federal sales and distributes through a dealer network alongside direct channels.

POPULAS emphasizes American engineering and craftsmanship backed by real-time phone support, a lifetime warranty on most items, and compliance with ADA guidelines and ANSI/HFES ergonomic standards. Products are also eligible for LEED certification points, reflecting a stated commitment to environmental stewardship.

name: PPSI
old_description: Our AS9100D-certified facility, IPC-610 trained technicians, and four decades of manufacturing expertise mean your products are built to spec and shipped on time, so you can focus on what's next.
about:
PPSI has been assembling electronics in Houston, Texas since 1986. Founded as a small PCB assembly shop, the privately held company has grown into an AS9100D-certified manufacturing partner serving aerospace, defense, space, industrial, and energy customers. Four decades later, the fundamentals remain: build it right, deliver on time, and communicate honestly.

The company provides end-to-end electronics manufacturing services from its Houston facility. Core capabilities include surface-mount, through-hole, and mixed-technology PCB assembly with component placement down to 01005 packages; custom cable and wire harness assemblies built to IPC/WHMA-A-620 standards; comprehensive testing and programming with AOI, X-ray, flying probe, and functional test; and full systems integration covering box build, electromechanical assembly, and conformal coating for harsh-environment and high-temperature deployments. Supply chain management services handle turnkey procurement, inventory, and fulfillment under a single quality system.

PPSI serves military and aerospace, space and satellite, industrial, and energy and oil-and-gas sectors. Customers include defense and aerospace programs requiring absolute precision, flight hardware and satellite components that must not fail, complex industrial control systems, and rugged electronics for downhole, pipeline, and refinery applications.

The company emphasizes stability from 40-plus years in business, AS9100D and IPC Class 3 quality controls, direct communication with the build team, flexibility in a high-mix environment, and a Houston location that supports site visits and audits. Its single-source model aims to reduce handoffs and accelerate time to market.
